detail: X-17 production ends 28 Feb 2027; X-17R is the proposed replacement.
X-17R contains a revised stabilizer package; equivalency is not certified.
AeroShield 420 coating is qualified for Binder X-17 only.
AeroShield 420 is qualified for EMEA customers with Binder X-17 only.
Formula changes for EMEA coating customers require Regulatory notification review.
Protective coating sold in US and EMEA.
US plastic additive does not use Binder X-17.
